what_is.a: PrediGol analyses football matches with data and statistical models: it shows a forecast of every match, compares the market's odds and publishes picks only when it finds value with enough evidence. It is information for people 18 and over: it takes no bets, pays no prizes and recommends no operator.

no_pick.q: Why is there no pick today?
no_pick.a: A pick is published only when a match meets every rule: value against the odds, enough evidence and a validated model. If no match meets them, there is no pick that day. We never fill the space with picks: Home tells you why there was none.

forecast_pick.q: What is the difference between a forecast and a pick?
forecast_pick.a: The forecast is the probability PrediGol computes for every match, bet or no bet. Value appears when that probability is higher than the one the odds imply. A pick is a case with value that also passed every publishing rule. The glossary explains the three layers.

guarantee.q: Does PrediGol guarantee I will win?
guarantee.a: No. No probability guarantees a result: a 70% chance fails three times out of ten. In “How PrediGol is doing”, once it is published, you will see the real results with their sample, the bad ones too.

cant_sign_in.q: I cannot sign in to my account
cant_sign_in.a: Check that your e-mail is spelled right and that caps lock is off. After several failed attempts the account waits a few minutes before letting you try again. If the sign-in screen shows “Forgot your password?”, use it: a one-use link reaches you. If it does not, or the link expired, write to us on WhatsApp or by e-mail (Contact, below) and we help you the same day.

two_steps.q: How do I turn on two-step verification?
two_steps.a: In your profile, under “Security”: you scan a code with an app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator and keep your recovery codes somewhere safe. From then on, signing in also asks for the app's code.

language_zone.q: How do I change the language or the time zone?
language_zone.a: The language changes with the ES / EN switch at the top. The time zone, in your profile: every time in PrediGol is shown in the zone you choose.

renew.q: How do I renew my membership?
renew.a: PrediGol does not charge cards inside the app. Write to us on WhatsApp or answer the reminder e-mail; once we record your payment, your membership is extended and you see it in your profile, under “Membership”, with its dates.

membership_ends.q: What happens when my membership ends?
membership_ends.a: We remind you a few days before. When it ends you have 3 days of grace with everything. After that the account has limited access: you still see your profile, your saved picks, this help, the legal texts and your data, and you get everything back as soon as you renew.

trial.a: A new account starts with a trial (usually 14 days) with full access. Your profile shows how many days are left; before it ends we tell you how to continue.

what_pick.a: A concrete selection — a market, an option and the odds it was judged at — that PrediGol publishes because it passed all its rules. Every pick says why it was published and is settled when the match ends; its result counts in the record, win or lose.

own_selection.a: A selection you save on your own, even if PrediGol did not publish it as a pick. It always carries the label “Your selection” so it is never confused with a PrediGol pick, and it does not count in PrediGol's results.

parlay.a: A parlay joins several selections into one bet: the odds multiply, but a single miss loses it, so the risk grows with every selection. While you build it, PrediGol shows the combined odds, its risk and whether two selections depend on each other.

when_settled.a: When the match ends and the data provider confirms the result, usually minutes after the final whistle. If the provider corrects a result, PrediGol settles that match's picks again and you will see the change in My picks.

void_half.q: What do refunded, void and half won mean?
void_half.a: Refunded: the stake comes back, for example when the result lands exactly on the line. Void: the match was not played or was suspended and the selection does not count. Half won (or half lost): on quarter-goal lines, half is won (or lost) and the other half is refunded. The glossary explains each one.

units.a: Every pick is measured as if 1 unit were staked: winning at odds of 2.10 adds 1.10 units and losing takes 1 away. The return is what was won divided by what was staked. With few picks those figures swing a lot, which is why they always come with their sample.

emails.q: Which e-mails does PrediGol send, and how do I turn them off?
emails.a: The ones about your account, its security, your privacy requests and important changes to the legal texts always arrive. Membership and support ones can be turned off in your profile, under “Notifications”. We never send advertising without your permission.

install.q: How do I install PrediGol on my phone?
install.a: On iPhone, open PrediGol in Safari, tap Share and then “Add to Home Screen”. On Android, open it in Chrome, tap the menu and then “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”. It opens like an app, without a store.

my_data.q: What data does PrediGol keep about me?
my_data.a: Your account's, your consents, what you save (picks, parlays, favourites), your messages to support and your membership. In your profile, under “Privacy and data”, you can download all of it in one file (we ask for your password) and ask for it to be corrected.

delete_account.q: How do I delete my account?
delete_account.a: In your profile, under “Privacy and data”, ask for the deletion: we ask for your password and handle it within the legal deadline (15 business days). Your account is anonymised: what is yours is deleted and only what the law requires is kept.

report_context.q: What is sent when I report a problem?
report_context.a: Your message and just enough to understand what happened: the screen you were on, the reference of the last error, PrediGol's version, the kind of device and whether you use the installed app. Never your password, sign-in links or what you typed in other forms.

should_bet.q: Should I bet on the picks?
should_bet.a: PrediGol informs; the decision is yours. If you decide to bet, set beforehand how much you can lose and do not go past it, do not chase losses and use only operators licensed in Colombia by Coljuegos.

get_help.q: I feel gambling is harming me
get_help.a: Talk to someone you trust or to a health professional. In “Responsible gambling” you will find the warning signs and Colombia's free help lines.

push.q: Can I get notices on my phone?
push.a: Yes: the result of what you save, your teams' line-ups, one summary a day, your account and the reminders you set with a match's bell. Turn them on in your profile, under «Notifications», or when PrediGol offers it. They never arrive from 22:00 to 08:00 (except your reminders), at most 3 a day, and you turn them off in one tap.

push_iphone.q: Why don't notices reach my iPhone?
push_iphone.a: On an iPhone or iPad, notices only reach PrediGol installed on the home screen (iOS 16.4 or later). In Safari, tap Share and then «Add to Home Screen», open it from its icon and turn them on in your profile. If you blocked them, allow them in Settings → Notifications → PrediGol.

survey.question: How useful was PrediGol to you this month?
survey.noPersonal: No personal data: if you write an email address or a phone number, we remove it.
survey.note: One question a month, never required. Your answer helps us improve the app; it changes no forecast and no pick.

survey.thanksBody: Whatever we change thanks to readers' comments, we will tell you in What's new.

updates.title: What's new
updates.intro: What changes in PrediGol, newest first. When a change comes from what readers tell us, we say so.

feedback.title: Your opinion, once a month
feedback.body: Now and then we will ask you how useful PrediGol was to you (once a month at most, and it can always be skipped), and at the end of every analysis and every pick explanation you can say whether it was useful. Whatever we change thanks to those comments, we will tell you here.

myPicks.title: My picks, complete
myPicks.body: Everything you saved, by day and with filters; the balance of your results with a notice while they are still too few to draw conclusions; your price against the closing price, and a CSV download of your data.

postmatch.title: After the match
postmatch.body: When a match ends, its After the match tab shows what PrediGol expected against what happened, how each published pick ended and why, and how what you saved ended.

whyPick.title: Why this pick?
whyPick.body: Every published pick explains its reasons in layers, the conclusion first, and says its state in words.

football.title: Your football first
football.body: Follow your leagues and your teams: Home, Matches and Picks start with them. You can change them whenever you like from your profile.

matchCentre.title: Match centre and PrediGol Analysis
matchCentre.body: Every match has its summary, the PrediGol Analysis with the data behind it, statistics, markets, line-ups and verified news with their source. Tap a term to see what it means.

help.title: Help, profile and the app on your phone
help.body: A help centre with common questions and «Report a problem» from any error; a profile that brings together your account, privacy, security and notices; and PrediGol can be installed on your phone like an app.

suggest.title: What would you like to change?
suggest.body: Tell us: we read every suggestion, and whatever changes thanks to them will show up here.
